notes.title: Hidden Cats Invade Venice price drop
notes.content:
Hello, cat seekers!

To celebrate its first anniversary, Hidden Cats Invade Venice is lowering its price. So if you haven't yet tried one of the most beautiful hidden cat games in 3D, now is the time to take the plunge!



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45116375/f64ec12d0bf06b5a6e9c99c6b76ccd237cdd9c08.gif"]

notes.title: New update : Visual hints
notes.content:
Hello cat lovers!

New update now available!

Some of you have been asking for visual hints, so here's an update to add this new feature!

We've added a new option to activate visual hints for those who can't hear the audio ones.
You can find it in the settings menu (click on the gear) and activate the ear icon as shown in the following screenshot:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45116375/1230f6170746aca35a7b82ee8993e6c3f88e1d15.gif

This will adds an indicator to the screen when a cat meows. What's more, as audio are directional, when this setting is activated, the cat emits a bubble to indicate the direction in which it is hiding, to recreate an equivalent of directional audio.

We hope you find this update useful and that you enjoy this new feature!

Have fun and see you in Venice!

[previewyoutube=F_jhVmLHUl4;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Steam Deck Compatibility!
notes.content:
Hello cat seekers!

Announcing compatibility with Steam Deck!

After testing, we are glad to announce that the game is compatible with Steam Deck!

The game works normally and we haven't noticed any particular malfunction. We hope you'll find it useful, and that you'll be able to take the game with you on all your adventures.

In addition, we've updated the game to correct the motion sickness reported on the camera in the first level, so we hope this will solve the problem some of you faced.

Feel free to report any bugs or problems you encounter on the game's Steam hub.

See you soon in Venice!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45116375/f64ec12d0bf06b5a6e9c99c6b76ccd237cdd9c08.gif

notes.title: 2 days before the release of Hidden Cats Invade Venice
notes.content:
Hello cat seekers!

Only 2 days left before the release of the game!

Here's some gameplay from the latest levels added to the game, the tower levels.

This mode is made up of a series of 5 levels that can be unlocked one after the other, through towers of different sizes and shapes, you'll have to find 200 cats who love to hide.

We worked on giving a unique ambiance through the colors of the fog and lights on each of them, we hope you'll enjoy exploring these 5 extra levels!

Feel free to try out the demo and wishlist the game if you like it!

See you soon!

[previewyoutube=LFnDRbZ4g4I;full][/previewyoutube]


https://store.steampowered.com/app/3071880/

notes.title: 6 days left before the release!
notes.content:
Hello cat lovers!

Only 6 days to go until the release of Hidden Cats Invade Venice.

We look forward to your feedback and comments on the game! We hope you'll like it as much as we do.
After months of work, we can't wait to finally press the publish button and share all the content we've created with you!

If you haven't tried the demo yet, feel free to download it and play the first full level available, and of course, if you like it, wishlist the game!

Hope to see you soon in Venice!

notes.title: New Tower mode with 5 levels!
notes.content:
Hello cat clickers.

Big news!
A new Tower mode with 5 levels has been created to give you 200 more cats to find.
These levels are of progressive difficulty, simpler and more accessible than the giant tower in the main mode.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45116375/185992111fadfa83a36151533fc362974909bed4.jpg

This brings the total number of cats to be found to 600.
The release is just around the corner. Add the game to your wishlist to be notified of its release.
And keep an eye out for more news about the game... There could be even more kittens to find.

See you soon to meet other fur balls!

 https://store.steampowered.com/app/3071880/

notes.title: [DEMO UPDATE] One full level!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45116375/62452cb6f6add9ebcbd65306c0a43bf49185a60e.gif

Hello cat lovers!

We've made a big update to the demo, allowing you to play the ENTIRE first level!

Why?
We've seen the first videos of the demo, and limiting the number of cats to 50 out of 100 gives the feeling that the game is pretty easy. In fact, it's true: finding the first 50 cats only takes 5 minutes, however, to find all 100 cats, you'll need more like 20 to 30 minutes.
So the demo wasn't at all representative of the final game.
We've therefore decided to offer you the first complete level in the demo, so that you can really judge the quality of the full game.

Of course, we'll be adding plenty of new content to the main game, as well as bonuses and secrets for the more attentive among you.

Have fun, and don't hesitate to send us your comments and feedback on this first level!

See you soon for more good news.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3101550/
